value.title: Outputs follow-ups (F75-F79)
value.summary: Make pij outputs find a verdict by its short head, print a human line on write, warn on off-list kinds and undefined subjects, and say where the index starts. Also: close a delivered request quietly (F83), and quote stored values in output.rs's printed next steps (F85).

sections.name: summary
sections.value: s06 (#137) works end to end; its first dogfood found five rough edges, one of which (F75) makes a merger read 'no verdict yet' when one exists. Small and self-contained: one coder after the PEC batch.

sections.name: goals
value: Make pij outputs find a verdict by its short head, print a human line on write, warn on off-list kinds and undefined subjects, and say where the index starts.

sections.name: non_goals
value: An outputs adopt verb for pre-s06 history (F79 is documented, not built).

value.claim: F75 (medium): `pij outputs --head` matches a unique prefix of 7 or more hex characters, as git does; an ambiguous prefix is refused naming the matches; fewer than 7 is refused with 'give 7+ characters or the full sha'. Never a silent `0 output(s)` for a head that has outputs.
F76: a successful `pij output` prints one human line (`wrote <role> <kind> on <subject> at <head7> (<result>); told <seat> (<mode>)`), with the raw receipt only under --json.

F77: writing an output whose kind isn't in the role's output_kinds succeeds with a warning naming the role's kinds and the `pij directory edit` fix. docs-system's role gains `verdict` (C7), through the verb.

F78: subject forms are defined: `pr:<n>`, `step:<sNN>`, `plan:<NNN>`, `doc:<repo path>`, or a ddocs address. Help and the API doc name them; any other form is written with a warning that `pij outputs --subject` only finds exact matches.
F79: the help and the API doc say the outputs index starts at s06 (#137, 2026-11-06), and older outputs live in each role's outputs folder and LOG.md. No adopt verb unless a role asks for one.

Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). No new timer, poll or launch. Prefix matching is one indexed range read on the existing outputs index; warnings are computed from data already read.

Docs and states. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md: head prefixes, the success line, the output_kinds warning, subject forms and where the index starts. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

F83 (crane's fleet, via the prime, 07 Nov): `pij requests close <id> [--why <text>] [--quiet]` closes a DELIVERED role request that was answered or abandoned (withdraw only takes queued ones). Allowed for the request's requester, its holder, a PA of the project, or the prime, checked from the stored row before any write. It stops the s12 limit clock, moves the row to closed_role_requests in one transaction (as withdraw does), notifies nobody with --quiet, and otherwise tells the requester once by FYI. (The other half of F83, a holder's --in-reply-to reply marking the request answered, is F68 in plan 214.)
value.note: Delivered by #149 (plan 212, fb87062): pij requests close <id> [--why] [--quiet] for delivered requests, with withdraw's authority plus the holder. Nothing left here.

value.claim: F85 (wildcat, 07 Nov): no printed next step carries an unquoted stored value. crates/daemon/src/http/output.rs (E-RS-OUTPUT-NOT-HOLDER's next, about lines 257-258) interpolates request.role and request.project raw; put each complete word through pij_core::directory::shell_word (or picture::command), and sweep http/output.rs for any other printed command built from stored values.
value.note: Delivered by #149 (plan 212): output.rs's printed next step quotes stored values, with a /bin/sh round-trip test (kestrel ef079fa, in #149's final push).

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Source: docs-system's s06 dogfood note, written with pij output (governance roles/docs-system/outputs/2026-11/06-note-step-s06.dd.json, 2026-11-06 23:50). F75: `pij outputs --subject pr:141 --head bfc5c54` gave 0 outputs while the full sha gave 1; the filename itself uses the 7-char head. F76 is the F31/F42/F58 family. F77: `pij output verdict --role docs-system` was accepted though the role lists deliverable, note. F78: only pr:N is documented. F79: about 20 hand-written docs-system outputs are not indexed.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
